packages.label: אֱמוּנָה וּתְפִלָּה וְנִסִּים
packages.reason: These concepts all share the essential nature of being above nature (לְמַעְלָה מֵהַטֶּבַע). Emunah is the prerequisite and essence of tefilla; tefilla is emunah in action; miracles are what is above nature; circles (egulim) are the form of emunah because faith surrounds and encompasses like a circle; woman/isha is the bechina of emunah in its receptive posture; Yishmael and Perita Sifvateh are both expressions of the mouth of prayer. The Torah explicitly equates all these as different facets of the same transcendent reality that breaks through the natural order.

packages.label: עֵצָה וְנִשּׂוּאִין — צַד הַקְּדֻשָּׁה
packages.reason: The core bechina of this Torah is that receiving advice from a person is structurally equivalent to receiving his seed — it is a form of marriage (zivug). Receiving advice from the tzaddik (counsel = holy marriage) is the bechina of yosef/tzitzit/shemirat habrit on the receiving side. Mount Sinai is where 613 counsels (etzot) were received, hence it is the bechina of etzot. The concept of 'ha-etzot she-mekabel me-hem' (the counsel one receives from tzaddikim) equals zivug/nissu'in in holiness. Note: the node 'etzot ha-nachash → nissu'in' appears here because it connects through the shared hub node 'nissu'in' — however the evil advice is structurally opposite in polarity; this is the good cluster anchored by etzah/nissu'in in holiness.

merge_notes.reason: The serpent's advice to Chava is explicitly called a bechina of nissu'in (marriage) in the proof text: 'ha-nachash hishi'ani — lashon nissu'in'. Although 'etzot ha-nachash' is evil, it connects through the hub node 'nissu'in' which is the structural concept unifying both sides. The evil polarity of this sub-node does not override the structural placement; it flags the dark-side dimension of the etzah-nissu'in bechina. The good/evil distinction within this component is captured in Package 3.

packages.label: עֵצוֹת רְשָׁעִים וְנִשּׂוּאֵי הַקְּלִפָּה
packages.label_en: Evil Counsel and Marriage of the Klipa
packages.reason: When one receives advice (etzot) from wicked people, it is the bechina of marriage with the klipa (nissu'in ba-klipa). This is the direct evil mirror of Package 2: just as receiving the tzaddik's counsel = holy marriage/zivug, receiving the wicked person's counsel = defiled marriage/zivug of the sitra achra. The node 'nissu'in ba-klipa' is structurally separate from 'nissu'in' because the klipa marriage is not merely a corrupted version but an independent entity in the evil domain.

packages.label: יוֹסֵף וְשְׁמִירַת הַבְּרִית וְצִיצִית
packages.reason: These concepts all share the same essential nature of sexual holiness and the protection of the sacred covenant. Yosef is the archetypal figure who preserved the brit (covenant of chastity); shemirat ha-brit IS the bechina of Yosef; tzitzit is the bechina of shemirat ha-brit because the fringes of the garment guard against the eyes and against the serpent's advice (sexual temptation); Shechem in the verse 'your brothers are shepherding in Shechem' is identified as a bechina of tzitzit (both are worn on the shoulders). The text uses the acronym 'va-eleh mosif' (ve-eleh adds) to show Yosef is the aspect of addition/increase (brit = the capacity to add holy offspring).

packages.label: נִאוּף וְנִשּׂוּאֵי הָרָשָׁע
packages.label_en: Adultery and Marriage of the Wicked
packages.reason: Marriage with a wicked person (nissu'in shel rasha) is structurally identical to adultery (ni'uf) — they are both expressions of the same spiritual defilement. This is the direct evil mirror of the Yosef/shemirat-ha-brit package: just as tzitzit protects from the serpent's counsel and wicked marriage, the evil side is defined by wicked marriage equaling ni'uf. The proof text states this explicitly: 'me-etzat ha-nachash, mi-nissu'in shel rasha, mi-bechina't ni'uf' — listing all three as equivalent evil states.

packages.label: אֱמֶת וְאִישׁ
packages.reason: Ish (man) is the bechina of emet (truth), just as isha (woman) is the bechina of emunah. Together, ish-isha = emet-emunah (truth-faith). The male principle (ish) embodies emet because emet is the giving, active, seeding quality — like the male who gives seed. The pair emet-ish is the good counterpart to the isha-emunah pair in Package 1. This Torah teaches that the union of ish and isha is the bechina of the union of emet and emunah, and on this the redemption depends.

merge_notes.reason: This pair belongs thematically to a broader truth/faith axis. Emet and emunah are closely related — emet is the active/male side and emunah the receptive/female side. The pair ish/emet should ideally merge with Package 1 (אמונה/תפלה) but the bechina connection between אמת and אמונה in this Torah is recorded as EITZA (edge 335: 'al yedei emet efchar lavo le-emunah'), not bechina. Per the rules, we cannot merge across eitza boundaries. Hence ish-emet remains its own package with a note that it is structurally related to Package 1.

packages.label: נִסִּין עִלָּאִין וְתְּהוֹם עִלָּאָה
packages.label_en: Upper Miracles and the Upper Deep
packages.reason: The upper miracles (nisin ila'in) are the bechina of the upper deep (tehom ila'ah). This is the supernal/upper dimension of the miracle-faith axis. The Torah describes two levels of miracles: nisin ila'in (upper miracles, corresponding to the supernal tehom) and nisin tata'in (lower miracles, corresponding to tehoma tata'ah). The upper level is associated with the higher unity (yichuda ila'ah) and deeper faith.

merge_notes.reason: This pair is thematically part of Package 1 (faith/prayer/miracles) — it describes the upper dimension of 'nisim'. However, there is no direct bechina edge connecting this pair to the main nisim/emunah cluster in the dataset. It is therefore kept as a distinct package but flagged as belonging to the same thematic domain as Package 1. A gap-analysis addition is proposed.

packages.label: נִסִּים תַּתָּאִין וּתְּהוֹמָא תַתָּאָה
packages.label_en: Lower Miracles and the Lower Deep
packages.reason: The lower miracles (nisin tata'in) are the bechina of the lower deep (tehoma tata'ah). This is the earthly/lower dimension of the miracle-faith axis, the expression of divine intervention within the lower worlds. Together with Package 7, they form the two dimensions (upper and lower) of the miracle-reality.

merge_notes.reason: Like Package 7, this pair is thematically part of the miracle/faith axis. The lower and upper tehom/nisin pairs (Packages 7 and 8) mirror the two-level structure of faith that this Torah teaches: emunah operates both above and below nature. These two packages could be merged with Package 1, but there is no direct bechina edge connecting tehoma/nisin tata'in to the emunah/tefilla cluster nodes. Kept separate pending gap-analysis verification.

packages.label: יַעֲקֹב וּבָנָיו וּשְׁנֵים-עָשָׂר נֻסְחָאוֹת הַתְּפִלָּה
packages.label_en: Jacob and His Sons and the Twelve Prayer Formulas
packages.reason: Jacob and his sons are the bechina of the twelve gates/formulas of prayer. The Torah explains that precisely Jacob and his sons descended to Egypt — because they are the bechina of prayer (twelve gates of prayer), and thus prayer itself went into exile. This pairs with the emunah/tefilla cluster but is a distinct structural node (twelve = the twelve tribes = twelve prayer gates).

merge_notes.reason: This pair is thematically part of the emunah/tefilla package (Package 1). The twelve prayer formulas connect directly to tefilla. However, the bechina edge does not connect these nodes directly to the main tefilla cluster — so it remains a separate component. Proposed for merge into Package 1 via gap-analysis addition.

packages.label: שׁוּרֻק וְטִפֵּי הַשֵּׂכֶל
packages.label_en: The Shoruq Vowel, Three Drops, and Three Brains
packages.reason: The shoruq vowel (three dots forming the u-sound) is the bechina of three drops (talt tipin), because the shoruq shape consists of three dots. Those three drops are in turn the bechina of the three brains (talt mochin = chochma, bina, da'at), because the drop of seed comes from the brain/intellect and reaches the kidney-vessels that produce seed. This is the Kabbalistic concept that intellectual/spiritual seed (the tzaddik's advice = drops of his intellect, as in 'hu mekabel tipei hasechel shel ha-tzaddik') flows like a drop from brain to reproductive organ. This cluster is NEUTRAL because it describes a structural/anatomical correspondence (vowel sign, drops, brains) that operates in both holy and profane contexts.

packages.label: מַס וְשִׁכְחָה
packages.reason: The letters mem and samech (which together spell 'mas' = taxation/burden) stood miraculously in the tablets; they are the bechina of forgetting (shikha). The connection: the Talmud says 'mem and samech in the tablets stood by miracle' (Shabbat 104a) — implying these letters were suspended without support, relating to the concept of forgetting (things that lose their support/foundation and disappear from consciousness). This is a neutral/structural bechina — a letter-concept pair that describes how forgetting operates in the spiritual-cognitive domain. Its thematic connection to the Torah is through the tzitzit/brit/memory axis (tzitzit helps against forgetting).

merge_notes.reason: This isolated pair connects thematically to the broader Torah through the emunah/forgetting axis — the Torah explicitly links emunah and its opposite (shikha/forgetting). However, the only bechina edge for this pair in this Torah is within the pair itself. Kept as its own package pending the gap-analysis check for whether additional bechina edges should connect it to Package 1 (emunah/tefilla), which is the domain of memory vs. forgetting in this Torah.
